B009-03.notes: u = 2^x: u^2 - 3u - 4 = (u-4)(u+1) = 0; u = 4 gives x = 2; u = -1 has no solution because 2^x > 0. Distractors C and D catch students who stop at u or keep the extraneous root. The substitution step is borderline hard for typical ACT takers.

B009-04.notes: 14 ft x 20 ft = 280 sq ft; 280 x 6 = $1,680. Trap B ($420) comes from scaling the area by 4 instead of 16.

B009-05.notes: Vertex (3,2) is inside [0,4]; f(0)=11, f(4)=3, so range is 2 <= f <= 11. Trap B uses only the endpoints.

B009-06.notes: Vertical angles are equal: 3x + 10 = 5x - 30 -> x = 20. D (70) is the angle measure.

flags: minor: no figure; a diagram would be typical but the text is sufficient
B009-07.notes: Altitude to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean: CD^2 = 4*9 = 36, CD = 6. This can also be done with similar triangles. Students who don't know the fact may struggle, so it's near the medium/hard line.

B009-08.notes: C(5,3)/2^5 = 10/32 = 5/16. Trap B (5/32) uses a wrong count of 5.

B009-09.notes: 20/0.75 = 26.67, so only 26 bottles are full. Trap C is rounding up to 27. Near the easy/medium line.

B009-10.notes: Spanish only = 60 - 20 = 40%. Not French is not 'only French'; percentages overlap consistently (union 85%).
